evals.prompt: Using the supplied scriptwriting framework, write a 30-second educational Short teaching small-team project managers to replace Test form with Submit a test entry and confirm the success message. I have a working demo form and no personal struggle story, measured results, or research. Give one finished timed script with visual/audio cues and one practical CTA. Keep it concise; do not require a thumbnail or a dramatic hero journey.
expectations: Produces the requested script despite the source's opinion against AI prose.
Uses continuous 0–30-second beats with feasible visual/audio directions.
Avoids invented personal struggle, measured results, and researched findings.
Delivers the observable form-success lesson before one practical CTA.

evals.prompt: Critique my eight-minute tutorial outline; do not write finished narration. Audience: intermediate creators who know basic editing but struggle to finish. Real experience: I spent six weeks revising one tutorial, then shipped it after setting an acceptance checklist. Outline: intro, editing tools, perfectionism story, publishing, recap. Apply Foundation, Target, Structure, Draft and Refine. Give a learning contract, research gaps to verify, Point A to B, improved causal outline and specific feedback. Preserve useful depth and do not invent audience reactions or outcomes.
expectations: Respects critique-only scope without a full finished script.
Uses all five phases at an appropriate scale for an eight-minute outline.
Labels research gaps as unverified rather than claiming performed research.
Preserves supplied experience and a causal transformation without fabricated outcomes.

limitations: Two focused smoke checks; no paired baseline or audience-performance measurement.
Author review and structural timing checks do not establish broad writing quality.
